families.name: What Neuma uses today
families.about: The engines already inside Neuma. This is the bar the new ones have to beat.

families.name: Chatterbox family (Resemble AI · MIT licence)
families.about: The research front-runner. One family in three sizes, all copying a voice from a 5-second clip. A being would sound the same on a big GPU or a laptop.

families.name: The Sesame lane: hears the conversation
families.about: Built the way Sesame's Maya is built. They listen to the earlier turns and shape how they say the next one. Judge them on the Dialogue clip above all.

families.name: The other contenders
families.about: Strong open models, each with a different trick.

kokoro.name: Kokoro
kokoro.one: Our current standard. The fastest engine here by far, and it runs on any machine.
kokoro.limits: Can't copy a voice: it uses its built-in 'Heart' and 'Michael' voices. It can't do emotion, so it reads every line the same way.

zonos.name: Zonos
zonos.one: Still the default engine on this machine. Copies a voice from a clip and takes an emotion setting (happy, sad, angry, surprised).
zonos.limits: Slow and heavy. It garbled the 'snow' line on both takes.

kyutai.name: Kyutai TTS
kyutai.one: Uses Kyutai's own voice prints of these exact two donors, so its voice match is the truest here.
kyutai.limits: No laugh or sigh cues. It can only use pre-made voice prints; making a new one is a separate step. The licence requires credit.

qwen3-tts.name: Qwen3-TTS (clip + words)
qwen3-tts.one: Alibaba's model, copying the voice from the clip plus the words spoken in it.
qwen3-tts.limits: It copies the donor's fast reading pace too. It can't laugh or sigh on cue.

qwen3-tts-xvec.name: Qwen3-TTS (as Neuma runs it today)
qwen3-tts-xvec.one: The same Qwen3 model, copying the voice the way our voice service does now: from a voice fingerprint only.

chatterbox-turbo.name: Chatterbox Turbo
chatterbox-turbo.one: The recommended pick from research. Trained to laugh, chuckle, sigh and gasp when the text says so. Small enough to sit beside the thinking model on a normal GPU.
chatterbox-turbo.limits: English only for the cues. It doesn't hear the conversation. It repeated one line once in the dialogue.

chatterbox.name: Chatterbox (original)
chatterbox.one: The original, larger Chatterbox. Instead of cues it has an 'emotion strength' dial, which we turned up for the intense lines.
chatterbox.limits: It can't laugh or sigh on cue. Slower than Turbo.

chatterbox-nano.name: Chatterbox Nano
chatterbox-nano.one: The tiny version, for people with no good GPU. These clips were made on the CPU alone. It takes the same cues as Turbo.
chatterbox-nano.limits: Listen for how much quality it gives up. This is what a laptop user would hear.

chatterbox-flash.name: Chatterbox Flash
chatterbox-flash.one: The newest member, built to be very fast.
chatterbox-flash.limits: Its fast mode broke on our GPU, so these clips come from its slower safe mode. It often leaves long silences at the end of James's lines.

csm-1b.name: Sesame CSM-1B
csm-1b.one: Sesame's own open model, the small early version of what powers Maya. It has no cues; it listens to the earlier turns and adjusts its delivery.
csm-1b.limits: Slow on this setup. Some clips have long pauses in them. Well below the real Maya demo.

misotts-8b.name: MisoTTS 8B
misotts-8b.one: A much bigger model built on Sesame's design. It's here as a quality ceiling.
misotts-8b.limits: Needs about 17 GB of GPU memory by itself, so most users couldn't run it. A few clips ran on into babble or stopped early.

dia2-2b.name: Dia2
dia2-2b.one: Built for two-person dialogue. It laughs, sighs and gasps, and performs the whole dialogue as one real conversation.
dia2-2b.limits: It misread two lines (the second takes of 'excited' and 'firm').

voxcpm2.name: VoxCPM2
voxcpm2.one: Copies voices cleanly and reads very accurately.
voxcpm2.limits: No cues. It takes its emotion from the words alone.

orpheus-3b.name: Orpheus
orpheus-3b.one: Laughs and sighs on cue, with a lively delivery.
orpheus-3b.limits: It can't copy a voice, so it uses its presets 'Tara' and 'Leo'. It made a few word slips. Its licence is Meta's Llama licence, which allows commercial use with conditions.

maya1.name: Maya1
maya1.one: Builds a voice from a written description and has 20+ emotion cues. It whispers on the intimate line.
maya1.limits: It can't copy a voice from a clip, so its Hannah and James are only approximations.
